Name: The Wizard's new Robes
Author: inmognito
Description:
So let's face it, the wizard is basically an older divorced guy who never leaves his home.  This mod just has him dressing the part.

Featuring: an event where the farmer gets introduced to the Wizard's dress sense.

[b]Installation
[/b][list=1]
[*]Download the file
[*]Unzip and paste into your Mods folder
[*]That's it!
[/list]
[b]How to trigger the event
[/b][list]
[*]Have two hearts with the wizard
[*]Visit the wizard tower before 10 AM
[/list]
[b]Compatibility
[/b][list]
[*]Not compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded
[*]You would need to disable the Wizard in any outfit mods you're using such as Seasonal Cute Characters or Diverse Stardew Valley
[/list]

Manifest.Name: (CP) the Wizard's new robe
Manifest.Description: Replace's the wizard's robe with a bathrobe
